purpose: Tracked cross-conversation snapshot. Read docs/affiliate-growth-state.json for the complete mutable source of truth and docs/affiliate-growth-runbook.md for operating rules.

serverStability.cause: intentionally concurrent full 118-page production runtime audit
serverStability.rule: Run full high-concurrency audits on a candidate or local immutable runtime; use bounded sampling on production.

cloudflare.testingRule: Send an Accept header containing text/html; default curl Accept */* does not match the HTML rule.

searchBaseline.interpretation: Complete-week impressions rose about 27% and average position improved 5.1 while clicks stayed flat; CTR and page-two movement are the nearer bottlenecks.

merchantAndSiteBoundaries.babyCj: Only the separately recorded bounded Bc Babycare pilot is authorized.
merchantAndSiteBoundaries.costume: Unchanged in this release; products remain database-backed and use the separate Abracadabra/CJ model.
merchantAndSiteBoundaries.petMedicationMerchant: CanadaPetCare remains blocked from public CTAs.

doNotDo: Do not add the 151 soft-launch pages to sitemap, IndexNow or external distribution before their gate.
Do not treat sitemap exclusion as noindex.
Do not broadly rewrite the 37 protected winners or 21 held pages without page-filtered evidence.
Do not run high-concurrency full production audits on the approximately 1.6GB server.
Do not use Cloudflare Purge Everything for ordinary content releases.
